# Test Prompt: Markdown Formatting Generate a response with these markdown elements: ## Headers ### This is H3 #### This is H4 ## Text formatting **Bold text** and *italic text* and ***bold italic*** ## Lists Nested unordered list: - Level 1 item A - Level 2 item A1 - Level 2 item A2 - Level 3 item A2a - Level 1 item B Nested ordered list: 1. First item 1. Nested first 2. Nested second 2. Second item 3. Third item ## Tables | Model | Context | Price | |-------|---------|-------| | GPT-4 | 128k | $0.03 | | Claude | 200k | $0.02 | ## Blockquotes > This is a blockquote > with multiple lines ## Strikethrough, task list, and an image The previous label was ~~obsolete~~ and should not be used. - [x] Calibrated the scale - [ ] Recheck the blank Here is a diagram: ![triangle sketch](https://example.com/triangle.png) ## Nested blockquote, autolink, bare URL, and a footnote > Outer note from the lab. > > > Inner note with a nested list: > > - nested aliquot > > - nested blank Autolink: Bare URL: https://example.com/lab-bare-url/with/a/long/path The method needs a citation[^fmt2]. [^fmt2]: Recorded in the lab notebook, page 12. ## Inline HTML First line.
Second line after an explicit break. The ion is written Na+ in running text.
